abilities.description: Restores mana equal to 25% of incoming enemy spell damage before reductions.
For every 300 spell damage that equipped hero receives, it gains a stack of Endurance for 5s up to a maximum of 6 charges. Each charge increases Eternal Shroud's magic resistance by 3.5% .

additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
9.8 main attack damage to universal heroes.
name: Eternal Shroud
description: A pristine hood that feeds upon strife to empower its owner.
